content: dpkt (kbandla/dpkt fork, pypi 1.9.8) parses Ethernet/IP/TCP/UDP/DNS layer-by-layer from raw bytes: eth = dpkt.ethernet.Ethernet(raw_bytes); if eth.type == ETH_TYPE_IP: ip = eth.data; if ip.p == IP_PROTO_TCP: tcp = ip.data; for DNS, filter UDP port 53 packets and parse udp.data as dpkt.dns.DNS(udp.data) to get queried qname and answer records. dpkt does not provide a built-in sniff loop like Scapy — pairs with a raw AF_PACKET socket on Linux or libpcap binding for the capture loop itself.
